observed.caption: A vibrant outdoor market stall displays colorful patterned fabrics, dresses, beaded jewelry and wooden crafts along a paved aisle.
observed.description: In the foreground and center, a market stall covered by a light-colored canopy and supported by metal poles displays numerous brightly colored patterned fabrics and garments hanging vertically, including a blue patterned dress on a mannequin on the right side of the stall. Beneath the hanging fabrics, a yellow tarp covers the ground with a red plastic crate underneath, and in the immediate foreground on a mat are piles of multicolored beaded bracelets and rows of small carved wooden figurines on thin metal stands. To the right, a paved pathway runs between stalls, with another stall on the right side holding folded textiles and assorted crafts. Three people are visible: one in the right foreground wearing a dark jacket and a long blue patterned skirt with a hand near the head, one in the mid-background wearing a checkered shirt and dark pants standing near the stall, and a partially visible person on the far right edge. Additional market stalls with more textiles and goods extend into the background under bright daylight.
